frontier.hypothesis: func_80052C10 is hand-written asm (li $t9 macro plus the asmpsx module-relative pad word), and its canonical-asm disposition needs a gate-class scan_hand_coded signal.
frontier.mechanism: Both residual hunks now lack a compiled-C producer under the build flags: the $t9 seat is class-killed in s6, and the trailing pad word has no compiled-C producer (s5).
frontier.next_probe: Escalation/forensics modality: file the proof-of-foreclosure record citing s2/s5/s6, or have the operator add a 'module-relative pad after the final jr delay slot' or 'frame-free $t9 temp' signal to tools/scan_hand_coded.py, which needs owner approval per the ruling.

frontier.hypothesis: This TU was compiled with different flags (e.g. -mabicalls) that make GCC prefer $25.
frontier.mechanism: With abicalls, the call templates move call targets into $25, which could create a copy preference toward reg 25.
frontier.next_probe: Forensics: look for abicalls fingerprints in the 3AB48 run (.cpload / $gp setup, jalr $25). None was seen in s1-s6, so expect a quick kill.

frontier.hypothesis: The module containing func_80052C10 starts at math_LerpSVector 0x80052788 or at gte_SetMatrixRotTransIRVec 0x80052A88.
frontier.mechanism: Module-relative 16-pad arithmetic (s5); padding cannot decide it because there are no pads in the run (s6).
frontier.next_probe: Compare the instruction idioms (li macro use, register conventions) of the two candidate module heads against the known asmpsx modules.

judge_constraints: No canonical-asm keep or grant for func_80052C10 without a gate-class STRONG scan_hand_coded hit (adding a new signal class needs owner approval, so it is not a grind lever). Next C shape: test the trailing nop as a TU boundary, with func_80052C10 ending its own object at 0x80052C24 and the 8-aligned next object starting at 0x80052C28. Measure it in a scratch build. Landing it needs bb2.ld/TU-split surface, so file an integration-handoff with the measurements. Separately, keep hunting the $t9 seat with a structurally different, frame-free chassis. Otherwise the function stays INCLUDE_ASM in the worklist.
